message.content: The sheer combinatorial explosion of chess is one of its most famous features.  In fact, the number of distinct legal positions that can arise in a standard 8×8 chess game is astronomically large – on the order of **10⁴⁶** different arrangements.  (A related figure, the “Shannon number,” gives a conservative lower bound on the game‑tree complexity of roughly **10⁴³**.)
